- Click this tool

- The first dimension defines the position
- Click this tool

- Click this tool

- Select two or more parallel oblique dimensions

- Click this tool

- The first dimension defines the position
- Click this tool

Inserts new contextual dimensions to the selection. Depending on your selection you might have several dimensions available. You can cycle through them using the M key. Left clicking on empty space will validate the current dimension. Right clicking or pressing Esc will cancel.

menu.tip:
New View

Inserts a new view into the current page based on the selected object in the tree view or 3D view. If no object is selected, a file browser opens to select an SVG or image file.
